summary: Reject loop-002 review evidence: the GoalExecution and bridge materialization resolved workspace-relative paths under work/tasks/TASK-0088 instead of the repository root, so the produced source changes and DB/artifact refs do not prove the main workspace implementation.

criteria.notes: loop-002 wrote workflow-a timeout changes under work/tasks/TASK-0088/src and tests under work/tasks/TASK-0088/tests instead of the repository src/ and tests/ trees.
The review evidence comes from the mis-resolved nested workspace, so it does not establish that the repository copy of src/ahra/ports.py was preserved by this task.
The bridge input refs point at work/tasks/TASK-0088/work/tasks/TASK-0088/runs/loop-002; the AWKP review must be rerun from a request whose workspaceRef resolves to the repository root.
